title: Fresh-seed (47) review of c42's condensate food chain: from noise, prey and predator condensates both divide and coexist to t=12000; the predator-free twin is a frozen emulsion; a fuel cut at t=6000 kills both kinds
summary: Re-ran the claimed world unchanged on seed 47 (128^2, 120 frames, t=12000, --lineage-k 5), its predator-free twin (pred_on 0) and the fuel-cut fork (tcut 6000) on the same seed. Smoothed-noise start; prey droplets (cyan) and predator droplets (orange) form by t=500, predators wrap prey into rings that break into arcs and new droplets, and both kinds are present to the end (prey 4-20, predators 20-36 droplets >= 6 px, sampled every 1000 t). labkit: predators 32 persistent splits, max generation 2, merge/split 0.18; prey 8 persistent splits, max generation 3, merge/split 0.11. The twin is a frozen hexagonal emulsion of 80-84 prey droplets (4 persistent splits, generation 1, all early). The fork: prey 8 -> 0 and predators 27 -> 0 by t=7000 while the fed run keeps 14 and 32.

observations.S: rerun/seed47/sheet.png t=0: smoothed noise over the whole domain, no planted bodies; droplets of both kinds by t=500
observations.I: rerun/seed47/sheet.png: discrete prey and predator droplets persisting between encounters, bounded size; counts in count.py output (prey 4-20, predators 20-36)
observations.X: nopred/seed47/sheet.png: matched twin (same seed, grid, duration) is a static emulsion of 80-84 prey droplets with 4 persistent splits (gen 1, formation phase) vs prey 8 persistent splits (gen 3) and a turning-over prey population of 4-20 with predators (rerun/seed47/FACTS.md species prey)
observations.D: rerun/seed47/lineage.png and FACTS.md: predator species 32 persistent splits (K=5, 500 t), generation 2, merge/split 0.18; prey 8 persistent splits, generation 3, merge/split 0.11; ring -> arc -> droplet predator divisions visible at t=3600-5200 and 9400-11500
observations.E: efork/seed47/sheet.png: fuel and regrowth removed at t=6000; prey 8 -> 0 and predators 27 -> 0 by t=7000, fed run (rerun/seed47) at t=7000 has 14 prey, 32 predators

verdicts.limitation: One seed. E is by construction (prey built only from fuel, predators only from prey, both decay). Predator generation stays at 2 with a 500 t lineage window; the default 2000 t window would count fewer. Prey divisions are few (8) and the counts per frame use a simple 0.5 threshold. No dt/2 or grid variant run by me.
